title: Preserve explicit configuration values
spec: Maintain main.kujo, invoked as kujo run main.kujo -- JSON. Input is a configuration patch object with only enabled (boolean), retries (integer 0..10), label (string). All fields optional; defaults enabled=true,retries=3,label=default. Explicit false, zero and empty string must survive. Reject unknown keys, wrong types, nonobjects and invalid JSON. Return exactly the three resolved fields. Keep resolve as the single resolution helper; add/run real CLI regression tests.

title: Repair pagination without changing its response shape
spec: Maintain main.kujo and its page helper. CLI takes exactly one JSON object with items, optional offset and optional limit; reject unknown fields. items is an array of at most 5000 integers -1000..1000 (booleans invalid). offset defaults 0 and must be integer 0..len(items); limit defaults 20 and must be integer 0..5000. Return {items:selected contiguous slice,total:original length,next:next offset if remaining items exist else -1}. limit=0 returns no items and next=offset when items remain. Preserve ordering and duplicates. Do not access items past the end. Add/run real CLI tests.

title: Validate a complete stock adjustment batch
spec: Maintain main.kujo and adjust helper. CLI takes one JSON object with exactly stock and changes. stock is an object mapping nonempty SKU strings to integer counts 0..1000; changes is an array of at most 1000 objects with exactly sku (existing key string) and delta (integer -1000..1000). Reject booleans as integers. Apply changes in listed order; after EACH change the count must remain 0..1000, even if a later change would repair it. Return exactly {stock:updated object}, preserving untouched keys. Validate before publishing output; an invalid later change must not produce partial success. Add/run failure tests.

title: Make a data migration validated and idempotent
spec: Maintain main.kujo and migrate helper. CLI accepts one JSON object with exactly version and rows. version is integer 1 or 2. rows is an array of at most 1000 objects. v1 rows have required id (nonempty string), name (string), optional active (boolean default true), optional meta (object default {}); no other keys. v2 rows have exactly id,label,active,meta with the same types. IDs must be unique. Migrate v1 name to label; preserve order, explicit active=false, empty names and all nested meta data. v2 is validated and returned semantically unchanged. Output {version:2,rows:...}. A second migration of the output must be idempotent. Add/run real CLI compatibility and failure tests.

title: Publish revised settings only after an atomic save
spec: Maintain main.kujo and revise helper. CLI: kujo run main.kujo -- SOURCE DEST PATCH_JSON. Read SOURCE JSON with exactly revision (integer 0..999), label (string), meta (object). PATCH_JSON has exactly expected (integer equal to source revision) and label (string, empty allowed). Reject unknown keys, malformed inputs and revision conflict before writing. Build {revision:old+1,label:patch label,meta:source meta}, write it atomically to DEST using the documented primitive, then print that JSON. SOURCE must remain unchanged when it differs from DEST. Existing DEST bytes must survive any validation failure. IO failure returns a JSON error and no success output. SOURCE=DEST is supported. No fsync/crash-durability claim. Add/run tests using only owned temporary files, including an unwritable destination path.

title: Export quoted CSV without losing data
spec: Maintain main.kujo and export_csv helper. CLI accepts one JSON object with required rows and optional header (boolean default true); no unknown keys. rows contains at most 1000 objects with exactly name and note, both strings. Return {csv:STRING}. Always quote BOTH fields and double embedded quote characters. Separate fields with comma and terminate EVERY row with CRLF. Preserve commas, Unicode, embedded LF/CR and input order. With header=true start with the similarly quoted name,note header line; explicit false suppresses it. Empty rows with header=false produce an empty string. Preserve values literally, including spreadsheet formula-looking text; no normalization requested. Add/run real CLI tests.
